Denying the Prophet told him secrets, Ali cited four whom Allah cursed: one who sacrifices to other than Allah, curses his parents, shelters an innovator or moves land boundaries.
The Prophet had a cursed camel unloaded and set loose, said cursers are neither intercessors nor witnesses on Resurrection Day, and that he was sent as mercy, not to curse.
Being human, the Prophet asked Allah that any curse, rebuke or blow he gave a Muslim become purification and nearness to Allah, as he told Aisha and Umm Sulaim.
Sent twice by the Prophet to call Mu'awiya, the boy Ibn Abbas found him eating each time, and the Prophet said, May Allah not fill his belly.
